title: GitHub job log hosts
description: The contents of github-log-hosts.yml: api.github.com and the exact hosts GitHub serves job log downloads from, as flax agents fetch-github-hosts derived them from https://api.github.com/meta. Exact host names only, never a wildcard.

hosts.description: Exact host names: lower case letters, digits, hyphens and dots, no wildcard.
